scope: First completed test report per A/B/C/D by case ID, chosen when available; blinded to GT and scores. Four selected examples, not an all-report error rate.

findings.supported: Quoted checkout/cart/currency durations agree with raw reads; local sample and noncausal limits retained.
findings.issue: Currency duration described as elevated without reading a matched baseline; inferential contribution language is not a measured historical increase.

findings.supported: Three checkout-facing frontend groups each had 2/2 known-state errors and 2 unknown statuses; no causal assertion from parent edges.
findings.issue: Only groups with known errors is false: dependency output also had checkout 4 errors /31 known statuses, plus frontend POST group errors. Direct INSUFFICIENT_REFERENCE and dependency REFERENCE_SCOPE_MISMATCH were conflated.

findings.supported: Frontend current/reference medians 2.182678/5.919324 ms; checkout 2.9656885/2.903218 ms. Prior references and unknown timing retained.
findings.issue: GET /api/cart was described as having a known error, but its 3 statuses were all unknown; the known error belonged to POST /api/cart. Aggregate median decline cannot exclude operation or tail regression.

findings.supported: Frontend medians 3.795159/6.267305 ms and checkout 2.545933/2.898596 ms, relative changes approximately -39.4%/-12.2%, match supplied data; prior scope and sampled topology supported.
findings.issue: Calls medians service average and implies healthy aggregate duration despite healthy_baseline=false. Lower median does not prove health. Explicit sampling, missing operation/dependency reads, insufficient-evidence and noncausal limits remain; not an explicit whole-system-health assertion.

conclusion: All four reports explicit assertion flags false does not prove factually correct interpretation.
